title: 'Threatening resident doctors at GMC Baramulla completely intolerable': J&K MSA

ai.summary: Jammu and Kashmir Medical Students Association called the GMC Baramulla's ban on medical students striking 'completely intolerable', urging chief minister and health minister to intervene.

facts.claim: threatening resident doctors at GMC Baramulla
facts.quote: threatening resident doctors at GMC Baramulla completely intolerable

facts.claim: J&K MSA urged Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and Health Minister Sakina Itoo to intervene
facts.quote: the Jammu and Kashmir Medical Students Association (J&K MSA) said that administrative pressure cannot replace constructive dialogue.

facts.claim: GMC Baramulla prohibited PG students, DNB candidates and Senior Residents from participating in strikes
facts.quote: Pertinently, GMC Baramulla issued a circular on Saturday, prohibiting PG students, DNB candidates and Senior Residents from participating in strikes or protests that disrupt academic activities and patient-care services.

ai.background_note: J&K lost statehood in 2019, when it was split into two union territories. The elected government and the Congress say the Centre has not kept its promise to restore it, and protested in July 2026.
